title: FedScan: static analysis of CI/CD-to-cloud OIDC workload identity federation trust conditions (software and pseudonymised dataset)
description:
FedScan is an open-source static analyser for OpenID Connect (OIDC) workload identity federation trust conditions in Terraform, OpenTofu and CloudFormation (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Cloud). It implements an eleven-class taxonomy of tenant-boundary, scope and hygiene flaws and emits JSON Lines or SARIF.

This archive also contains the measurement and analysis pipeline and the pseudonymised binding-level dataset that accompany the article Trusting the Pipeline: Measuring OIDC Workload Identity Federation Misconfigurations Across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Repository identifiers are pseudonymised with a keyed hash; file paths and resource names are withheld.
